ExtraBar 1.2.6 – Redesigned for Clarity! ⚙️✨

⚙️ Settings Overhaul

  • Position Mode Picker: "Display Modes" is now "Position" with beautiful visual cards – tap to select Menu Bar or Floating Bar instead of the old toggle!
  • Collapse Mode: Renamed "Menu Mode" to "Collapse Mode" across the entire app for clarity!
  • Streamlined Appearance: Bar Size and Icon Labels moved from Accessibility to Appearance – all visual settings in one place!
  • Reorganized General: Dock Icon and Menu Bar Icon pickers now live in General settings for easier access!
  • Unified Shortcuts: Three separate hotkey sections merged into one flat "Shortcuts" list – no more hunting for your keyboard shortcuts!
  • Better Navigation: Collapse Mode picker changed from toggle to segmented control for clearer mode selection!
  • Cleaner Labels: "Toggle Bar" renamed to "Show / Hide Bar" for better clarity!

🎨 UX Polish

  • Simplified Copy: Removed redundant subtitles and descriptions across all settings – less clutter, more focus!
  • Specific Language: Replaced vague "items" with specific terms like "apps" and "icons" – always know what you're working with!
  • Solid Backgrounds: All settings now use opaque backgrounds instead of translucent blur – better readability and consistency!
  • Unified Navigation: All back buttons now use the same style and position throughout the app!
  • Smooth Transitions: Fixed inconsistent button animations when entering or exiting multi-select mode!
  • Icon-Only Footer: Footer buttons simplified to icon-only with helpful tooltips – cleaner interface!
  • Streamlined Permissions: Simplified the Accessibility permission popover for easier understanding!

⚡ Technical Improvements

  • High-Res App Icons: App icons now load in high resolution, avoiding macOS Tahoe's padded rendering – crisp and beautiful!
  • High-Res SF Symbols: SF Symbols in the floating bar now render at stunning high resolution!
  • Scalable Menu Icons: Collapse Mode menu icons now properly scale with your bar size preference!
  • True Transparency: Transparent mode now produces a truly invisible bar – hooray for minimalism!
  • Native Menu Bar Size: Menu bar icons bumped from 18pt to 22pt to match native macOS status item size!
  • Smooth Navigation: Fixed flash when navigating back from the action editor!

🚀 What's Next?

We're constantly refining ExtraBar based on your feedback! This settings redesign makes the app more intuitive and easier to navigate – but we're not stopping here! More improvements are on the way!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraBar community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make – keep it coming! 💙
